name: Feast of Trumpets (Yom Teruah)
description: A set-apart day of shofar blowing and worship, marking the beginning of the 7th month.

name: Day of Atonement (Yom Kippur)
description: A solemn day of affliction, prayer, and repentance before Yahuah.

name: Feast of Tabernacles (Sukkot)
description: Seven days of rejoicing in temporary dwellings to remember our wilderness journey.

name: Last Great Day (Shemini Atzeret)
description: A sacred assembly on the 8th day, closing the Feast of Tabernacles.
